mentions.name: Garmin watch BYOK AI app
mentions.description: A Garmin watch AI app that supports bring-your-own-key (BYOK) inference. It has been updated to run OpenRouter's OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow entirely on the watch, giving users a seamless BYOK experience instead of requiring them to copy/paste their Gemini API key into settings.
mentions.problem: Formerly users had to copy/paste their Gemini key into settings, which was a huge barrier.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just updated my Garmin watch AI app (https://untether.watch/en/apps/byok) to run the whole flow on the watch for a seamless BYOK experience - formerly you had to copy/paste your Gemini key into settings, which was a huge barrier.

evidence.value: I just updated my Garmin watch AI app (https://untether.watch/en/apps/byok) to run the whole flow on the watch for a seamless BYOK experience - formerly you had to copy/paste your Gemini key into settings, which was a huge barrier.
